name: Argentiferous-Yardang

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond crystal cavern networks the sky stays the color of a bruise.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Whoever controls copper controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
